full_judgment: 26. We have also carefully considered the judgment of the Court of Settlement. We find all the old documents of the property in possession of the petitioners. Findings of LTIs. and signatures in Urdu (as alleged) cannot go to a conclusion that the petitioners are citizens of Pakistan and their property is an abandoned property. Further, the alleged LTI were not sent to the expert for examination. Non-submission of voters'' list and Ration Cards does not also mean to include the property as abandoned property as it is not required under Article 2 of President''s Order 16 of 1972. Findings as regards the citizenship of the petitioners and their education, etc. are absolutely based on presumption without being supported by any material and legal evidence on record.
